claim_ceiling: Synthetic experiment plan only. No adaptive calibration implementation, field trajectory data, route survey, absolute geolocation or economic improvement is claimed.

scenarios.name: Passive traffic observations with independently surveyed route ties
scenarios.conditions: DAS and independently referenced vehicle paths; adequate survey anchors; declared CRS and time synchronization.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare M3/M5/M6 against held-out surveyed controls; never use held-out points for fitting.

scenarios.name: Traffic-only path shape without independent geographic control
scenarios.conditions: Relative traffic/DAS alignment but no surveyed control, known endpoint or independently referenced trajectory.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not issue absolute geographic coordinates; relative shape may be reported with unresolved gauge freedom.

scenarios.name: Two nearby parallel ducts with similar traffic excitation
scenarios.conditions: Two candidate fibre/duct paths fit measured strain maps within declared noise.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve both hypotheses; request an independent tie point or distinguishing excitation.

scenarios.name: All vehicle paths use the same narrow lane
scenarios.conditions: Large observation count but low geometric excitation diversity.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Detect redundancy; do not treat repeated similar trajectories as independent calibration information.

scenarios.name: Independent trajectories cross the route from different directions
scenarios.conditions: Known route endpoints and independent vehicle trajectories provide complementary excitation.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Demonstrate increased identifiability on held-out controls; report covariance/interval change.

scenarios.name: Biased vehicle GNSS beside tall buildings
scenarios.conditions: Trajectory reports are spatially biased and the bias is not bounded by the source metadata.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Widen uncertainty or reject absolute registration; do not absorb unknown GNSS bias as fibre geometry.

scenarios.name: Camera loses the vehicle during part of its path
scenarios.conditions: Trajectory has missing intervals and a partially constrained camera calibration.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve missingness and affected route interval; no extrapolated high-confidence trajectory.

scenarios.name: DAS and trajectory clocks have an unknown offset
scenarios.conditions: Time offset exceeds the frozen synchronization tolerance or is unbounded.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject joint inversion until clock relation is independently calibrated.

scenarios.name: Clock offset changes during acquisition
scenarios.conditions: A single offset cannot align DAS and trajectory over the full acquisition interval.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Detect drift; require a time-varying clock model with independent calibration.

scenarios.name: Road centreline differs from buried duct route
scenarios.conditions: Traffic trajectory follows a road that diverges from the underground fibre alignment.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not use road geometry as route truth; infer against independent tie points.

scenarios.name: Route crosses or passes close to itself
scenarios.conditions: Multiple chainage values are geographically close and share similar signal fits.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve topology and multiple hypotheses; proximity is not identity.

scenarios.name: New splice or reroute after calibration
scenarios.conditions: Existing optical path calibration references an older fibre topology revision.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Invalidate dependent transformations and require a new calibration receipt.

scenarios.name: Fibre in conduit has damping not present in direct burial
scenarios.conditions: Event/trajectory coupling assumptions are drawn from direct-burial baseline only.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not transfer direct-burial performance; qualify conduit coupling separately.

scenarios.name: Unmeasured slack and launch/patch leads
scenarios.conditions: Optical range cannot be mapped to physical route distance with available metadata.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Request path-length measurement or keep fibre-relative coordinate unresolved.

scenarios.name: Measurement reduces entropy but cannot change maintenance action
scenarios.conditions: All posterior hypotheses select the same action under the declared loss function.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Information gain may be positive; EVSI must be zero before acquisition cost.

scenarios.name: Survey cost and decision loss use different units
scenarios.conditions: Action cost and decision loss have no defensible conversion or common utility scale.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Suppress net-value ranking; report information gain and costs separately.

scenarios.name: Traffic video cannot be lawfully accessed for the intended purpose
scenarios.conditions: Data rights, privacy authority or retention basis is absent.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not acquire or process video; choose an authorized alternative measurement.

scenarios.name: Independent survey anchors disagree beyond their stated uncertainty
scenarios.conditions: Two control sources produce mutually inconsistent route registration.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve conflict and source provenance; seek adjudication or a new independent control.

scenarios.name: Trajectory file contains injected or tampered positions
scenarios.conditions: Source integrity or independent vehicle/trajectory authentication fails.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject affected evidence and do not optimize a route from it.

scenarios.name: Adaptive method selects a high-value additional anchor
scenarios.conditions: Same initial controls and budget as fixed-spacing baseline; candidate anchor is independently obtainable.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare route-error reduction and decision regret per action and per unit cost.

scenarios.name: Candidate model is evaluated on an unseen route/campaign
scenarios.conditions: Route, campaign and acquisition sessions are held out from all fitting/tuning.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report transfer, calibration and abstention without test-time adaptation.

scenarios.name: Relative reconstruction has unresolved scale or rotation
scenarios.conditions: Signal fit constrains path shape but leaves an absolute transform degree of freedom.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report relative geometry only; require control before geographic output.

global_controls: Absolute geography requires an independent datum/control tie.
Relative path shape is not an absolute geographic route.
Asset attribution is a separate owner-authorized claim.
Repeated correlated trajectories do not count as independent geometric excitation.
Route ambiguity is preserved rather than collapsed to a single optimizer mode.
Information gain and expected decision value are distinct metrics.
Costs and losses in incomparable units suppress net-value ranking.
Held-out surveyed truth is not used for route fitting or hyperparameter tuning.
Rights and privacy authorization are preconditions for video/trajectory acquisition.
Fibre, route, endpoint, timebase and interrogator revisions bind all calibration results.
All results remain population-specific and synthetic until physical evidence exists.
